 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR VERMA  ORAL ORDER 4 21-06-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. for the State.

The petitioner seeks bail, who is in custody since 05.08.2021 in connection with POCSO Case No.57 of 2020 arising out of Suryapura P.S. Case No. 141 of 2020, F.I.R. dated 27.09.2020 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341,342,323,376,120(B),34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4/8 of POCSO Act, 2012.

Earlier the prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected vide order dated 06.04.2022 passed in Cr.
Misc. No.55377 of 2021.

Thereafter, the petitioner has again moved before this Hon'ble Court in Cr.
Misc. No.69893 of 2022 which was also dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 14.12.2022 Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.5917 of 2023(4) dt.21-06-2023 with liberty to file a fresh application before the learned court below.
Vide order dated 01.02.2023, a report was called for with regard to the stage of the trial.
Report of the learned Trial Court dated 14.02.2023 reveals that out of 13 chargesheet witnesses, seven witnesses have already been examined.
